title: Work reads: prevent abandoned CLI requests from starving the current view
outcome: Round-1 Claude Medium, work_visualizer.rs:224: the two process-wide semaphore permits move into blocking CLI reads and remain until exit even after client abort. Rapid A/B/C project switches, details reads or multiple windows can get 429 while obsolete reads run up to the 6-second deadline. Source-inspection finding, not a live reproduction. Distinct from doctor concurrency tm-kwu8 and dispatch work-binding latency tm-pl7k. Reproduce under real HTTP cancellation semantics; choose cancellation ownership, bounded admission waiting, or an explicitly bounded retry policy without unbounded queued processes. Transport helper reuse, post-exit pipe cleanup and misleading doctor diagnostics may be addressed in the same path if warranted.
acceptance: Deterministic slow-CLI/HTTP regression covering quick project switches and current request recovery; demonstrate bounded process/reader ownership and request latency; genuine overload remains explicit.
